init.title: Easee Smart Charging settings
init.description:
**Charge modes**
- **Normal**: charges right away at full power, whatever the price.
- **Smart**: charges in the cheapest hours so the car is ready at your departure time.
- **Solar**: charges only on solar surplus (1 or 3 phases automatically), otherwise waits.
- **Solar + smart**: uses solar surplus first; what is still needed is charged in the cheapest hours, so the car is ready on time.

Work through the sections below once; each one explains its settings.

menu_options.charger: Charger: phases, current and default mode
menu_options.grid: Main connection: smart meter for solar charging

solar.title: Solar panels and solar forecast
solar.description:
Optional. With a forecast, **Solar + smart** counts on the sun that is expected before your departure and buys less from the grid; the planning chart shows the expected sun as a dotted line.

- **Own forecast**: link the power sensor of your inverter. The integration fetches the weather (Open-Meteo, three weather models) and learns from your own history the orientation of the panels, how much they make, shade and the season. Works with any brand.
- **From a sensor**: use a forecast sensor that has an `hourly` list, such as *Enphase Envoy Local* → Forecast today.

data_description.pv_power_entity: Needed for the own forecast. A recognised sensor is filled in already. The longer its history, the better the forecast.
data_description.pv_kwp: Only used until enough history has been learned (about 3 weeks).

equalizer.title: Easee Equalizer
equalizer.description: Do you have an Easee Equalizer? Pick it here; when nothing is filled in yet, the Equalizer the Easee integration knows is picked for you. Found: {found}.

data_description.equalizer_device: Choose — if you don't have one. With an Equalizer, solar charging uses its measurements instead of a meter.
data_description.show_equalizer: Automatic shows it as soon as an Equalizer is linked.

dashboard.title: Create dashboard
dashboard.description: Adds a ready-made **Easee Smart** dashboard with all cards to your sidebar. Your own dashboards are never overwritten. Already created by this integration? Then it is refreshed with your current cars and settings.

data_description.phase_confirm_minutes: How long the sun has to stay below/above the 3-phase minimum (4.1 kW) before switching. Default 3 minutes.

data_description.test_charge: Charges for 5 seconds at the minimum current when a car is plugged in, to check the plug and the car. No current? The car is woken up, and you get a notification if it still does not charge.
